omens.text: Your torches burn lower here, with no draft to explain it.
The floor ahead is warmer underfoot than the one behind.
The air smells faintly of rain, a long way from any weather.
A sound from the room you just cleared comes back once, a fraction late.
The corridor ahead is no narrower than the last. Your shoulders find the walls anyway.
The chalk marks you left on the way down are a hand's width higher than you remember making them.
Dust lies in the grooves of the stone, every one of them pointing the way you are going.
The torchlight reaches farther ahead than it does behind you.
Your shadows lean toward the way down, whatever the light says.
For a moment, all of you breathe in time.
A slow pulse rises through the stone, slower than your own.
When you look back, the room you cleared is smaller than you remember.
